note: Printed by scripts/apply-branch-policy.ts --print-parity, and after every apply, so a reader always knows which GitHub guarantees Forgejo cannot give. Degrade gracefully: never fail an apply because of a gap.

githubOnly.mitigation: PAP-527 merge automation serialises merges and reruns `ci / check` on the merge result before pushing; block_on_outdated_branch approximates the up-to-date requirement.

githubOnly.gap: No per-branch linear-history rule on Forgejo.
githubOnly.mitigation: Repository settings allow only squash and rebase merge styles (PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo} allow_merge_commits=false); the rebase-before-push workflow keeps history linear.

githubOnly.gap: Forgejo branch protection has no metadata pattern rules.
githubOnly.mitigation: commitlint in the commit-msg hook and in `ci / check` is the authoritative check on both forges; pr-lint (PAP-49) checks the branch name.

githubOnly.gap: Forgejo sets allowed merge styles per repository, not per protected branch.
githubOnly.mitigation: Repository-level setting; recorded here so the difference is visible.

githubOnly.gap: Forgejo whitelists are all-or-nothing per branch.
githubOnly.mitigation: Use the narrowest whitelist (bot-atlas only) instead of a partial bypass.

githubOnly.gap: Forgejo cannot pin a status context to a specific app.
githubOnly.mitigation: Context name `ci / check` only; bot token scopes (PAP-48) limit who can report it.
Use --dry-run on the apply script for the diff instead.

forgejoOnly.note: Finer than CODEOWNERS. Left empty for now; CODEOWNERS plus ownership.json is the single ownership source (doc §8).
Set true. GitHub's equivalent is simply having no bypass actor.
